sentences.text:
Ramnarayan versus Avinash Champavat
 Order Sheet
 10/06/2025 Dr. Sudeep Agrawal, counsel for the petitioner.

Mr. Raghavendra Pradhan, Mr. Vivek Singhal and
 Mr. Vijay Kumar Deshmukh, counsel for

. 
In compliance of this Court's order dated 30.04.2025, both the contemnors Mr. Amrit Vikas Topno,
Collector, Sakti, District Sakti (C.G.) is present before this Court through video conferencing and
Mr. Baleshwar Ram, Sub Divisional Officer (Land Acquisition Officer), Dabhra, District Sakti (C.G.)
is present before this Court in person.

This Court has gone through the Affidavit filed by the Collector and Land Acquisition Officer, Sakti,
District Sakti (C.G.) and other relevant documents appended thereto as also documents pertaining to revenue record, notification under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act 1894, demand letter and other relevant record filed by the petitioners with covering memo, and this Court direct the Contemnors to ensure strict compliance of this Court's order dated 12.02.2021 passed in WPC No.
710/2021 and payment of compensation to the petitioners in lieu of acquisition of their land within a period of 04 weeks from today, failing which both the contemnors shall appear before this Court for hearing on framing of charges.
On this date, both the contemnors shall remain present before this Court.

Sd/-
